findings.message: daemon_escalation_hook touches config loading, subprocess spawn, JSONL append, and retry-budget gating, yet edge_cases is empty. Idempotency (double-escalation) is even covered by an enumerated test (test_retry_blocked_tasks_does_not_double_escalate) without being captured as an edge case in the spec. Concurrent JSONL appends and missing-config paths are not surfaced anywhere.
